calibration.method: Full-file bytes/4 is the existing conservative source-context planning proxy; it is not actual token use, semantic-review duration, or a lower bound on targeted-range reads. Current resolution is partial; omitted files can only increase whole-file footprint. No implementation tests ran.

provenance.probe: Python stdlib-only read-only filesystem, BEAM CInf external-term decoding, archive manifest inspection, hashing and historical set reconciliation; no project/OTP evaluator, parser, loader, atom-creator or test command invoked.
limitations: Source paths selected from pinned local BEAM compile-info using unique longest matching path suffix; this is sizing input, not SweepEvidence semantic citation acceptance.
Fourteen pending modules per lane were unresolved by this local-file probe. Archive/source-only resolution was not substituted for them.
Original-row match unions use preserved historical budget MFA sets. Current full installed export-set equality has not been tested or claimed.
Source-set digest serializes sorted Python tuple representations of local path suffix, SHA-256 and byte size; it is a probe digest, not the calibration artifact's canonical source-set digest.
